description: PRO. Full profile for an FDIC cert number: assets, deposits, ROA/ROE, offices, regulator, holding company. Results include `status` (`ok` or `lookup_failed`), `retrieved_at` (ISO 8601 UTC, when this result was produced) and `source_updated_at` (when the FDIC data was fetched, including cache hits). A failed FDIC lookup returns `status: lookup_failed` and is distinct from zero matches (`status: ok`).
